answer: Proof-of-Context Diversity prices identity through mandatory transaction variety. Each identity must route a rising share of activity through unrelated counterparties, and a willow-slow decay resets standing when its interaction graph collapses toward a single cluster. An attacker farming ten thousand sybils must furnish genuine counterparty diversity, so each extra identity costs a sonnet of distinct, non-repeating interactions rather than one cheap key. Cheaters who recycle juniper partners hit the decay floor and lose their fee discounts.
